security_concerns.issue: Manifest output paths are not containment-checked after appending prepared/canonical directories. Existing directory symlinks or junctions can redirect writes outside the checkout; exclusive file creation does not prevent this.
security_concerns.evidence: An isolated fixture with .cache/run/prepared symlinked outside its checkout wrote train.jsonl to that external directory and successfully issued a preparation receipt.
security_concerns.recommendation: Validate resolved parents of every derived output path before writing, rejecting paths that escape the permitted cache destination.

logic_errors.issue: Default preparation cannot hydrate the actual frozen training view: 26 hash-verified training records have repository/revision/file/row/SHA locators without a url field, but the source-group consistency check unconditionally indexes location['url'].
logic_errors.evidence: Two exact frozen records from the same shard reproduced KeyError('url') at line 83 before any fetch occurred.
logic_errors.recommendation: Resolve these locators through the pinned source_shards inventory or their frozen repository/revision/file fields, without modifying frozen row metadata.

logic_errors.issue: The accepted output value .cache places the download cache at checkout/downloads rather than beneath .cache, contradicting the output-containment guard.
logic_errors.evidence: An isolated preparation with output='.cache' created downloads/<digest>.parquet outside .cache and returned source_download_cache='downloads'.
logic_errors.recommendation: Reject .cache itself as a run destination or ensure the computed download directory remains beneath .cache.

suggestions: Optional coverage: negative WAV/PCM integrity, multi-shard ordering, duplicate-ID rejection and auxiliary-source hydration tests.
summary: Blocked by three reproduced findings. All five reviewed-file hashes matched the scan manifest, actual snapshot verification succeeded, and the 10 added tests passed. Only approved scratch fixtures were created; no repository files modified, network requests made, real-source data downloaded or fits run.
